title: Projection of minimum and maximum temperatures in cold regions of Iran using SDSM statistical downscaling model
authors: Azar Zarrin, Dina Yazdani, Abbas Ali Dadashi-Roudbari
abstract: This study used the CanESM2 climate model and the SDSM statistical downscaling method to project minimum and maximum temperatures across Iran’s cold regions under three future climate scenarios. The results indicate a clear warming trend in all future periods, with stronger temperature increases under RCP4.5 and RCP8.5, particularly in northwestern Iran. These changes could accelerate snowmelt and threaten freshwater availability in Iran’s arid and semi-arid regions.
